title: Layers & Objects
description: Stack work on layers, and find, hide, lock, and reorder every object on the page from one list.

bubble.title: Layers & Objects
bubble.body: Layers stack groups of objects — draw on one without touching another. The list under the layers is every object on the page, in stacking order.

bubble.title: Watch: a shape joins the list
bubble.body: Press Watch demo: the program draws a rectangle and points at the list. Adding a layer is a button press — that part is yours, next.

demo.title: Drawing on the active layer
demo.body: A rectangle, drawn with I. It lands on whichever layer is active.

demo.title: It is in the list
demo.body: The new rectangle appears in the object list under its layer — named, in stacking order, with its own eye and lock.

bubble.title: Add a layer
bubble.body: Click + Add Layer in the Layers & Objects section. A second layer appears and becomes the active one — new drawing lands there.

bubble.title: Draw on the new layer
bubble.body: Steer to a corner and press I to start a rectangle.

bubble.title: Finish it
bubble.body: Steer to the opposite corner and press I again. This rectangle is on the new layer — hide the first layer later and it stays.

bubble.title: Hide an object
bubble.body: In the object list, click the eye next to one of your rectangles. The object stays in the document, just invisible. Click the eye again to bring it back.

bubble.title: Fade a whole layer
bubble.body: Select the first layer in the list, then lower its Opacity. Everything on that layer fades together — layers have their own transparency.

bubble.title: Two lists, one page
bubble.body: Layers group objects; the list under them is every object on the page — hide, lock, and reorder from there. Stacking objects within a layer is the Grouping & Ordering tutorial's job.
